name: AI Tab Tidy: dedupe and cluster tabs, name groups with icons
what: One click in the vertical strip organises the window: duplicate tabs are closed, related tabs are clustered, each cluster gets a title and an icon, and groups are moved to the front. A status string reads Organizing tabs.

Each batch is POSTed to https://api.aside.com/tabs-tidy/plan with title, URL, hostname, pathname and tokens; the cloud returns groups {title, icon, tabIds}. Applying uses tabs.move, tabs.group, tabGroups.update, then moves the Agent Tabs group to index 0. Timings per phase are recorded and sent as analytics event tabs.tidy.
